cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Gillian, it's me. Listen carefully. It's about Queen Hospital.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: They built a large underground extension in 2030. That's right.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: The hospital has a basement.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Underground construction is rare in Neo Kobe.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: That's why there was a record of it. There's more.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: The director, Chin Shu Ho, used an underground facility

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: to perform illegal surrogate-mother operations.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: His practice was suspended because of it.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: So there's a medical facility underground?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: There's no doubt about it.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Chin Shu Ho is servicing Snatchers underground.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Then Chin is a Snatcher too.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: No, they snatched him because he had the facilities they needed.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The facilities above ground are a cover for it.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Taking out this hospital will stop the Snatchers' advance.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: This is it, Metal. We're going into their base!

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Gillian.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Hm?

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Your work is dangerous. I want you to come back safely.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Jamie.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: I left you because I thought you were forcing yourself.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: No, because I felt you were.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: We were wearing wedding rings when they found us.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: I wondered if that had become a burden to you.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: If that was all that kept us together, it would be too sad.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: That's not true.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: I'll be waiting, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: We may have no memories,

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: but we're the only ones who shared that time together.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Be careful, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Jamie.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Can you leave it at that?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Let's go, Metal. To Queen Hospital. Her Majesty awaits.
